messages:
sam-sales: Urgent — PulseAI POC started load runs and is getting a mix of 429s. Demo in 1.5h, theyre anxious.
nina-support: Which endpoints and can you paste a raw 429? Also what client (serverless lambdas, browser, etc.)?
sam-sales: Mostly /v1/completions from a serverless fleet (lots of short-lived instances) + occasional /v1/embeddings. They said connections churn a lot. Sample 429 (redacted):
```json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","reason":"per_route_burst","route":"/v1/completions","retry_after":null,"request_id":"pa-77b"}
```
They also reported some 429s with no Retry-After header ~30% of the time.
omar-eng: Two things jumping out: 1) per-route burst limiter hitting because many concurrent short requests + connection churn increases effective QPS; 2) token-burn rate guard can also fire when completions+embeddings burn tokens concurrently. Important: serverless clients often open new TCP/HTTP connections which increases connection overhead and can amplify limiter triggers.
felix-oncall: Ill pull live tenant counters and check SLO graphs, give me 2m.
quota-bot: Fetching tenant counters for tenant=pulseai-poc...
quota-bot: month_commit=600000; month_used=25k (4.2%); inflight_token_estimate=11.9k; per_route_burst(/v1/completions)=700/min; per_route_rps=100
omar-eng: Inflight tokens ~12k with serverless churn explains the bursts. Also the missing Retry-After is an on-path edge-case — filed it but not the demo blocker. Two immediate options: A) temporary presales bump to per-route burst + short token throughput allowance for the demo window, B) ask the client to reduce concurrency and reuse connections (or switch to HTTP/2 multiplexing) and implement backoff. For serverless, recommend connection pooling or a short-lived warm container to reuse keep-alive sockets.
sam-sales: They want the demo bulletproof. Can we do a temporary bump for 3h and also provide a short checklist to them?
felix-oncall: I can apply per-route burst bump to 2200 and token throughput delta +90k tokens/sec for 3h. Need sales approve.
sam-sales: Approve. We'll mark temporary and ask them to optimize after.
quota-bot: Quota change requested: tenant=pulseai-poc, route=/v1/completions, burst=2200, duration=10800s, id=Q-188765-04
quota-bot: Token throughput change requested: tenant=pulseai-poc, delta=90000 tokens/sec, duration=10800s, id=TB-188765-04
deploy-bot: Changes applied. Per-route burst set to 2200 and token throughput allowance +90000 for tenant `pulseai-poc`. Expires at 1887664921.
sam-sales: Re-running their harness now.
nina-support: While they run, here's a short checklist to send them: 1) reduce serverless concurrency or use a warm-worker pool; 2) enable HTTP keep-alive or HTTP/2 to reuse connections; 3) cap client max_concurrency <= 12 for demos; 4) stream long completions to avoid big single-request token spikes; 5) batch small embedding calls; 6) implement exponential backoff and honor Retry-After when present.
omar-eng: Backoff snippet to share (pseudocode): `base=0.4s; attempt=0..n; if Retry-After: sleep = Retry-After + random(0, 0.2*Retry-After); else: cap=30s; sleep = random_between(0, min(cap, base * 2**attempt))`.
felix-oncall: Monitoring: 6m after change, 0 429s and token burn inside temp allowance. We'll auto-revert at expiry. Filing follow-up bug for missing Retry-After header.
sam-sales: Client reran and reports no 429s, demo looks stable. They asked whether we can provide a short pre-warm for future demos instead of repeated bumps.
omar-eng: We can propose a presales option: temporary pre-warmed token pool or demo credits + a sustained presales quota for paid tiers. Recommend opening a presales quota request if they plan frequent demos.
sam-sales: I'll file the presales request and send the optimization checklist + note the temporary bump. Thanks all! :rocket:
felix-oncall: Marking this thread for a follow-up: 1) presales quota request, 2) ticket for Retry-After missing, 3) docs update on serverless connection churn best-practices.
